title: Improving Lives and Livelihoods: Poverty and Equity Assessment for El Salvador 2024
temporal_coverage: Poverty and climate analysis published in 2024; includes historical exposure and forward-looking risks.
methodology: Country poverty assessment combining household and climate evidence.
limitations: Conflict links are conditional risks, not measured outcomes.

title: Contribuciones Nacionalmente Determinadas de El Salvador 2025
organization: Government of El Salvador, Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources
temporal_coverage: 2025 NDC; adaptation objectives and strategic targets mainly cover 2030–2035.
methodology: Government NDC based on sector and territorial vulnerability analysis and interagency consultation.
limitations: Commitments and planned systems are not evidence of completed results.

title: The World Food Programme's Contribution to Improving the Prospects for Peace in El Salvador
organization: Stockholm International Peace Research Institute, with World Food Programme field research
temporal_coverage: Field research conducted in March 2019; findings describe the then-current program and conflict context.
methodology: Two-week country case study using interviews, focus groups, programme review and project-site visits.

title: Evaluación de Vulnerabilidad y Adaptación al Cambio Climático en El Salvador
organization: Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources of El Salvador; ESSA Technologies Ltd. and associates
temporal_coverage: Municipal vulnerability baseline and projections for 2021–2050 and 2071–2100, published February 2018.
methodology: Indicator-based two-territory municipal assessment with participatory adaptation prioritization.
limitations: Focuses on the AMSS and selected Eastern Dry Corridor municipalities, not all of El Salvador.
